clues.text: On "我的推广", the visible "新建推广" button can have a zero-sized accessibility rectangle while its live DOM rectangle is nonzero; if semantic press and plain DOM click fail, a full pointer/mouse event sequence on that uniquely verified button activates it.
The standard-promotion budget drawer opens from the row's info/description icon, contains percentage inputs for "高峰日上调" and "预算耗尽上调", and applies them with the visible "保存设置" button.
The promotion-time editor exposes a "全选" checkbox, a 7-day by 24-hour grid, and a visible "保存修改" button.
Switching to dual-platform bidding opens a confirmation dialog with "仍要切换"; afterward separate bid inputs are labeled "点评" and "美团".

In the promotion-time editor, hour-item grid cells ignore plain click(); they need the full pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click sequence. Mapping is row=hour 0-23, col=周一..周日; uncheck 全选 first to clear all, then select cells.
On the new-promotion page, the 极速推/标准推 cards are .promo-version__item; the selected card has a "checked" class. Activating a card needs the full pointer event sequence, not plain click().

In the merchant date-picker calendar, clicking the day cell (__cell) does not register; the selection only applies when the innermost .merchant-date-picker-panel-calendar-month__date-date node is clicked with the full pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click sequence.

On the standard-promotion creation page, the "更多设置" row opens a drawer only via its pencil edit-icon inside .cc-more-setting-flat__value (not by clicking the row or label). The drawer shows 曝光渠道 selection and a 地域拓量 toggle with a 保存设置 button.
